_comment: Overload gear lines. Roll ranges from nikke.gg/overload-equipment (15 roll levels; max = level 15). Up to 3 lines per piece, 4 OL pieces. stat maps to a sim buff bucket; inert stats (hitRatePct, defPct) are allowed but do nothing in v1. `name` is the game's own line label, verbatim from the CDN equip_option_table_v2-en `description_localkey` (fetched live 2026-08-23) — the synced-roster backend forwards these strings and web/src/rosterApply.ts matches on them exactly. The table also carries a 10th line, 'Increased Recovery' (group 2000), deliberately absent here: damage-inert and unmodeled, it surfaces in the synced-roster unmapped diagnostic by design.
